categories.main_business_segments: Jourdeness Group operates primarily in the beauty and body care industry, encompassing research, development, manufacturing, and sales of beauty and body care products, as well as providing professional beauty and SPA courses. The company also manages direct-operated and franchised beauty salons and operates a tourism factory. Its business model integrates product sales with service offerings across multiple channels including physical stores, e-commerce, and international distribution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D with a focus on innovative formulations and patented technologies such as NANOTOBI lipid carrier technology, BGKI microbial gene engineering, INSK microbial fermentation, freeze-drying 3D FCT technology, and NaDES natural deep eutectic solvent extraction. It also develops plant-derived extracellular vesicles (PDEVs) for enhanced skincare efficacy and employs multi-stage fermentation techniques to produce bioactive ingredients. Production follows ISO 22716 GMP standards and includes strict quality control from raw materials to finished products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jourdeness serves mainly female consumers seeking high-quality skincare and beauty treatments. Its primary markets are Taiwan and Mainland China, with expanding presence in Malaysia, Vietnam, and other Southeast Asian countries. Customers include individual consumers purchasing products and services through direct-operated stores, franchisees, and e-commerce platforms. The company also targets professional beauty salons and SPA centers as part of its distribution and service network.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nearly 560 beauty and body care chain stores across Taiwan, Mainland China, Malaysia, and Vietnam. It has subsidiaries and branches in key cities such as Taichung, Taipei, Guangzhou, Kuala Lumpur, Ho Chi Minh City, and others. The company’s manufacturing and R&D facilities are primarily located in Taiwan, with sales and service operations spread across Greater China and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jourdeness operates mainly in the midstream segment of the beauty industry supply chain, focusing on product research, development, manufacturing, and direct retailing of beauty and body care products. It also manages downstream activities including franchising, direct-operated stores, and SPA service provision. The company maintains control over its supply chain through in-house production and quality management, ensuring product consistency and service standards.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in natural and sustainable beauty products, integrating biotechnology and AI-driven ingredient discovery. R&D focuses on anti-aging, whitening, skin repair, and environmentally friendly formulations aligned with SDGs. It pursues academic collaborations, patent development, and advanced extraction and fermentation technologies. Strategic goals include enhancing education and training standards, optimizing store efficiency, deepening member engagement, and expanding international OEM and franchise businesses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of beauty and body care products and provision of professional beauty and SPA courses. The company operates a hybrid model combining direct sales via company-owned stores, franchised outlets, e-commerce platforms, and international distributors. Additional income streams include brand licensing, OEM manufacturing, and tourism factory operations. The company also issues convertible bonds and employee stock options as part of its financial strategy.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In Mainland China, Jourdeness competes with regional and international beauty chains such as Christina, Ziranmei, Siyanli, Bellis, Weimeidu, and others. The company holds a leading position in Taiwan and has established brand recognition and market share in Greater China and Southeast Asia. Its competitive advantages include proprietary R&D, integrated supply chain, extensive franchise network, and strong brand reputation supported by multiple international awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$2.28 billion, a 23.36% decrease from the prior year, primarily due to reduced tourism and slower economic recovery in China. It experienced a net loss of about NT$292 million. The company maintains total assets around NT$7.39 billion and equity of NT$1.77 billion. Despite recent setbacks, it plans to leverage its extensive store network and R&D capabilities to drive future growth and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jourdeness emphasizes high-quality, safe, and innovative beauty products tailored for Asian skin types, supported by proprietary patented technologies and sustainable natural ingredients. It offers a comprehensive beauty ecosystem combining products with professional SPA and skincare courses delivered by certified therapists. The company’s vertically integrated operations ensure consistent quality and service standards, while its strong brand and extensive training programs foster customer loyalty and franchisee success.
